item.title: Ukraine Sent Drone Experts to Protect U.S. Bases in Jordan, Zelensky Says
item.summary: As the war in Iran spreads, Kyiv is eagerly offering its hard-won expertise and advanced technology to counter Iranian drones.

item.title: U.S. Tomahawk Hit Naval Base Beside Iranian School, Video Shows
item.summary: The evidence contradicts President Trump’s claim that Iran was responsible for a strike at the school that killed 175 people, most of them children.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the Conflict on Sunday
item.summary: Iran named Mojtaba Khamenei, a son of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, as his father’s successor. The Pentagon announced the death of a seventh U.S. service member.

item.title: Who Is Mojtaba Khamenei, Iran’s New Supreme Leader?
item.summary: The selection of a son of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, who was killed in a strike on his compound at the start of the war, could anger Iranians seeking change.

item.title: Mojtaba Khamenei, Son of Iran’s Slain Supreme Leader, Is a Mysterious Figure
item.summary: The succession of the slain leader’s son is seen as a signal of the Islamic republic’s defiance of Israel and the United States, and of continuity during crisis.

item.title: State Dept. Said to Order Diplomats in Saudi Arabia to Leave
item.summary: The ordered departure of U.S. employees in the kingdom indicates that senior diplomats are bracing for a possible surge in violence in the war with Iran, officials say.

item.title: Pentagon Announces Seventh U.S. Death in War With Iran
item.summary: The service member killed was not publicly identified, but U.S. Central Command said the death was caused by injuries after an attack on a Saudi military base.

item.title: U.S. Continues Airstrikes Against a Wide Array of Targets in Iran
item.summary: A senior U.S. military official said those targets included missile launchers and air-defense sites.

item.title: Lebanese Villagers Bury Hezbollah Fighters, Praising Their Defiance of Israel
item.summary: After a fierce ground fight between Israeli forces and Iran-backed Hezbollah, the village of Nabi Sheet mourned its dead. “We are not here to bow,” said one villager. “We will not kneel.”

item.title: West Bank Violence Intensifies, as Israeli Settlers Kill 3 Palestinians
item.summary: A rise in settler attacks is terrorizing Palestinians in the occupied territory, at a time when global attention is focused on the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran.
